reviews.title: Great RPG Idle
reviews.text: If your looking for a relaxed Idle RPG you’ve found it!  Great mechanics, relaxed environment, and friendly and helpful community!

reviews.title: Zero originality, potential dogwhistle
reviews.text:
The obviously AI generated art makes your game look low budget and poor quality. 
The constant lag and barely functioning idle aspects drag it down quite a bit… and the use of “degen” is heavily associated with the alt-right. Unclear if this was an intentional dogwhistle or just a poor decision by the dev.

reviews.title: Give it a try!
reviews.text: Great game, awesome concepts. As close to an MMO as you can get in idle form / text form.

reviews.title: Game good, dev lacking focus, end game TBA
reviews.text:
Got into this game at Feb 2026 jump. It’s great if you want a true idle, 6-8hr idle time and you can do craft/gather with combat at the same time. Has some features like dungeons and world boss that can occupy people liking to check in more often. Which is great, but took 3 months to get drops to a somewhat normality.

The playerbase is small, but it could grow, and even so, it’s great for what it is. But if you’re looking for competitive anything, you won’t find that…yet. 

The dev had promised an update for months that still isn’t dropped. When that happens it could change a lot things  and focus. There is a strong market that has everything you need, the ability to create 3 characters for free, 2 more with $10usd. With just three you can get into high level play and join a guild within a month. Official game discord has a ton of help, and guilds offer plenty more, especially the top two. 

I would definitely give this a plus for a lot of reasons great community, no p2w at all, and great backbone to build on. The community alone is worth it, and you’ll, be satisfied for a few months at this pace. But the game had bigger potential if Kinde or Cold would get off their behinds.

Hopefully it picks up steam as it did in feb-march with some cool events, big boosts, and great community interaction. But as of late May 2026, Dev MIA. It’s voided. Voididle.

reviews.title: Not Bad
reviews.text: It’s a simple idle mmo from what I’ve experienced so far. Can definitely have a lot more content like minigames and things like that. These kind of games are always missing macros as well. Have to manually come back and change tasks if you want to get things in a certain order.

reviews.title: Unintuitive
reviews.text: Really bad unintuitive game with zero QoL. I don't think devs play their game. It doesn't tell you how to get anything and everything needs something else. Can't cook because no fish, can't fish because no bait, no guide where to get bait. Chopped wood but can't make planks because need some other obscure material. Trash game. Add tooltips, devs.

reviews.title: AMAZING IDLE
reviews.text: It’s so good I love the depth it has lots of rafters others missing do god

reviews.title: Too long
reviews.text: The game itself is interesting. It just wakes way too long to do anything. Creating the tools to speed things up require long periods of combat farming the dungeons just to hope to get a blueprint. And the blueprint is needed to craft each item, not a once acquired you can use indefinitely. Mind you, there’s like 8 types of tools, and multiple grades/tiers of each tool. I would enjoy the game if I didn’t have to spend a whole day collecting one resource, and then have to idle another resource for another day just to get the materials to make a bunch of the same item, for xp not use. Takes way too long to do anything.

reviews.text: What would make this game so dope is if my character profile screen in game could show my gear like my mage hat and robes and possibly my staff could show slightly would be so cool for everyone , and were you can see your equipped gear you can see your character completely geared out .

reviews.title: Definitely fun idle
reviews.text: I decided to play this game with my whole household. It is a lot fun but there are a lot little quality of life things I wish were tweaked not quite sure where to ask for those.  But overall we’re all hooked and trying to coordinate to eventually afford a guild. The paid features/membership is underwhelming though. As a whole the game is fun to manage and try to slowly build up and coordinate. I’m glad there’s no adds, wishing we could edit our characters icons at the beginning at least.  But It’s really cool you can multiple characters going at the same time. I wish there were the typical quest giving npc.

reviews.title: So far so good
reviews.text: I have to say that in the market of idle games this one is fun so far. It’s not money hungry like others and making it pay to win. It has an optional membership and a free trial for it. But it is truly fun so far. I hope more classes come and if when you make a new character if you can choose between a man or woman profile. I do look forward to new content and to keep growing my new characters. On another note I read through the reviews and love how they respond even to bad reviews and they want to make a fair and great game. Keep updating and making a fun idle games.

reviews.title: Great game w/ a Bright Future!
reviews.text:
Honestly a great game. This hits all of the things that I’m looking for! No paywall at all, and even if you feel like you need the membership, it can be earned in-game.

Looking forward to the further development of this, but it has a bright present, and an even brighter future!

reviews.title: Nothing works at all. Extremely buggy
reviews.text: Game is completely broken. I try to make a wool bowstring. I have the materials. I tell it to make a single one. The progress starts and I go do something else to let it finish in the background. I come back and no progress has been made. So offline doesn’t work at all. Major problem 1.  So then I just let it finish while active and when finished it starts making a second one even though I told it only make 1. Major problem 2. So then I hit stop and go check my inventory and I have no bowstring anywhere. It never made anything. Major problem 3. Not worth playing at all.

reviews.title: Good game but flawed
reviews.text:
As an idle game, it has a lot of depth and choices to it. However it feels bogged down by the UI being clunky and long calculation times. The game just doesn’t feel smooth or intuitive. 
Also they want a subscription for access to the whole game.  Something just rubs me the wrong way when it comes to idle games asking for monthly subscriptions. The game is all about waiting, so it feels like you’re paying to just wait? I’d much rather just pay $10-$15 outright if I like the game for full access.

reviews.title: Reminded me of Melvor idle the RuneScape game for phones but this one seems way more polished.
reviews.text: I stopped playing Melvor because I couldn’t get immersed into the game, it had a lot to it just like this game but I feel like I’ve taken a liking to this game because I can visually see loot and the overall UI feels like they actually intend to invest time into this game. It’s promising and there’s so much they can still add to the game. I wish there was more socialization with other players like server chats to ramble away while ur afk farming or party chats to find other players to party with. Great game just needs a lil more to thrive.

reviews.title: Fun idle, still rough around the edges
reviews.text: Enjoyable idle game with polished visuals and fun gameplay loop. However some implementation still feels pretty rough around the edges: every action triggers a spinning wheel and brief wait time, including selecting a skill to practice. Activities and items are often out of sync and a restart is needed to clear things up. Active discord and bug reporting system helps, but it feels closer to early access than a release ready game right now. It’s heading down a great path and look forward to playing more when the bugs are ironed out!

reviews.title: Bad directions
reviews.text:
Game gives zero info on how to do anything. Need scrolls to craft anything. Where do you find them, who knows! 

Event going on that gives a currency that you craft into a second currency. But all the event items are for a third currency. How do you get them, who knows! 

I don’t need to be force fed info, but I need a resource to point me in the direction. And no, going to the Discord does not count. 

Play one of the other better versions of this.

reviews.title: Looking Good On Day 1
reviews.text: Dev made a good job, I chopped wood, made charcoal out of bones, and making planks like a good little Warrior.

reviews.title: Interesting concept, poor originality
reviews.text: I like the idea of leveling skills and building characters. But this game is an streamlined copy of Melvor Idle. There isn’t much going on in the game. You make a character, start farming a skill. And wait for hours to gain 1 level. Then do it all over again. I could write this games code in about 24 hours using basic XCode and ChatGPT image generator, which is exactly what the developer did. There just isn’t enough engaging elements to keep me playing.

reviews.title: Forced login is a no-go
reviews.text:
I’d like to try this, but right now it looks like the only way to create a character is by connecting via an external website, which you have to use a Google or Apple login to create an account - no guest account or local device account possible, which is insane. 

If this is broken and unintentional, hopefully it can be fixed soon. If this is actually as intended, it’s a very poor design choice.

reviews.title: OSRS Vibes
reviews.text: Been playing the web version, def reminds me a lot of old school games like runescape but text based. Nice to play a few times a day.

reviews.title: Fun idle mmorpg
reviews.text: Love this game. I haven’t played an idle mmo like this but it’s great and reminds me of RuneScape.

reviews.title: Asset flip cash grab with predatory IAP
reviews.text:
It’s 99.99% identical to IdleMMO with flipped assets a fraction of the content multiple QoL behind IAP and that lovely predatory business model of prices are always just higher than the currency pack. Also you start with less inventory space than there is gathering and crafting skills and yes inventory space is an IAP.

The only original and unique thing this game added over IdleMMO is a class system with a basic skill tree and a half attempt at “builds” but also in an idle game with no combat animation the only thing this does is change how fast numbers go up and which stats make numbers go up faster so it’s really just a “which icons do you want on your screen.” Choice

reviews.title: 1st idle game & I’m hooked
reviews.text: I hadn’t played an idle game before but love RPGs. This game has me hooked. I can level up, craft items, and do combat - all while working. Excited to continue playing!

reviews.title: Loving the Dungeons
reviews.text: Degen Idle is an absolute gem! This hyper-engaging idle game hooks you from the first tap, with addictive progression, stunning art, and a delightfully unique theme. Devs Kinde and Cold knocked it out of the park – endless fun, and a vibrant community. 5/5 stars without a doubt – a must-play for idle enthusiasts and casual gamers alike!

reviews.title: Addictive and surprisingly deep idle game
reviews.text: Been playing Degen Idle for a couple weeks and I’m actually hooked. It’s the kind of game you open just to check progress and end up playing for an hour. The upgrades and rewards feel super balanced, and there’s always something new to unlock. It’s perfect for when I’m on the train or zoning out after work. One of the best idle games.
